old: 71 international experts in eight panels considering 570 studies
cutoff 30% if healthy, at least 40% if frail, cholangitic, cholestatic or malnourished
84% of its 570 studies are observational and that most surgical recommendations sit at level of evidence 4

new: The Milan jury-based consensus covers staging, drainage, liver augmentation, resection, systemic therapy, transplantation and outcomes; 84% of its 570 studies are observational and most surgical recommendations sit at level of evidence 4. Hypertrophy is a specific exception: PVE is the initial technique (Recommendation 23), and upfront or additional LVD may be considered for substantial augmentation (Recommendation 24), both strong, level 3, with limited nonrandomized pCCA comparative evidence. Transplant Recommendation 59 concerns selected unresectable or PSC-associated pCCA ≤3.0 cm without nodal or distant metastases (strong, level 3); Recommendation 64 only weakly supports consideration in resectable or questionably resectable disease with appropriate donor access (level 3). Benchmark and retrospective data do not establish universal superiority over resection, and TRANSPHIL failed to recruit. The consensus size boundary is separate from OPTN’s strict <3 cm mass criterion. Resectability criteria still need validation. Industry covered 55% of the conference’s costs, no individual author conflict statement is printed, and no voting record is reported.

option_key_remaps.old_lead: Gadoxetate-enhanced MRI, read against the LR-M feature set The most studied single test. Rim arterial phase hyperenhancement, peripheral washout, delayed central enhancement and targetoid diffusion restriction are the features that pull a tumour out of the HCC algorithm. Targetoid appearance alone was present in 75.8% of cHCC-CCA — but also in 65.2% of matched HCC, so by itself it separates almost nothing.
option_key_remaps.new_lead: Gadoxetate-enhanced MRI, read against the LR-M feature set Gadoxetate MRI assesses rim arterial phase hyperenhancement, peripheral washout, delayed central enhancement and targetoid diffusion restriction. Targetoid appearance occurred in 25 of 33 cHCC-CCA (75.8%) and 23 of 66 matched HCC controls (34.8%), giving 65.2% specificity; it raises suspicion but does not establish mixed histology.

option_key_remaps.old_lead: Transarterial chemoembolisation The most used modality and the one with the most supporting data, though all of it is retrospective and the benefit is confined. Post-operative adjuvant TACE was independently associated with better overall survival (HR 0.2, p=0.005, no confidence interval reported) in 95 radically resected patients, and in 306 resections it improved early recurrence-free survival only in HCC-dominant tumours, with overall recurrence-free and overall survival both non-significant even there (p=0.068 and p=0.549).
option_key_remaps.new_lead: Transarterial chemoembolisation Dedicated retrospective TACE series include unresectable and recurrent cHCC-CCA; enhancement-pattern associations do not establish a causal treatment benefit. Keep the following adjuvant cohorts separate from those treatment settings. Post-operative adjuvant TACE was independently associated with better overall survival (HR 0.2, p=0.005, no confidence interval reported) in 95 radically resected patients, and in 306 resections it improved early recurrence-free survival only in HCC-dominant tumours, with overall recurrence-free and overall survival both non-significant even there (p=0.068 and p=0.549).
